zh.action.item_list.label: Eagle 列出条目
zh.action.item_list.description: 按条件筛选列出 Eagle 资源库条目，分页返回。
zh.action.item_query.label: Eagle 全文搜索
zh.action.item_query.description: 在条目名称、标签、注释、URL、文件夹名等范围全文搜索，支持 AND/OR/NOT 与短语。
zh.action.item_count.label: Eagle 条目总数
zh.action.item_count.description: 返回资源库中的条目总数。
zh.action.item_add.label: Eagle 添加条目
zh.action.item_add.description: 通过 URL / 本地路径 / Base64 / 书签添加条目，支持单条或 items 批量（最多 1000）。
zh.action.item_update.label: Eagle 更新条目
zh.action.item_update.description: 更新条目元数据：名称、标签、文件夹、注释、评分等；仅修改提供的字段。
zh.action.item_set_thumbnail.label: Eagle 设置自定义缩略图
zh.action.item_set_thumbnail.description: 从本地图片为条目设置自定义缩略图。
zh.action.item_refresh_thumbnail.label: Eagle 刷新缩略图
zh.action.item_refresh_thumbnail.descriptio: 重新生成条目缩略图，同时更新文件大小、尺寸和颜色信息。
zh.action.item_get_comments.label: Eagle 获取标注
zh.action.item_get_comments.description: 获取条目的所有标注（图片框选或视频时间轴）。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.item_add_comment.label: Eagle 添加标注
zh.action.item_add_comment.description: 为条目添加标注。图片提供 x/y/width/height，视频提供 duration。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.item_update_comment.label: Eagle 更新标注
zh.action.item_update_comment.description: 更新已有标注，仅修改提供的字段。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.item_remove_comment.label: Eagle 删除标注
zh.action.item_remove_comment.description: 从条目移除标注。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.folder_list.label: Eagle 列出文件夹
zh.action.folder_list.description: 列出 Eagle 文件夹，支持可选筛选，分页返回。
zh.action.folder_create.label: Eagle 创建文件夹
zh.action.folder_create.description: 在资源库创建新文件夹；省略 parent 则创建在根级别。
zh.action.folder_update.label: Eagle 更新文件夹
zh.action.folder_update.description: 更新文件夹元数据（名称、描述、标签、图标颜色）或移动到其他父级。
zh.action.smart_folder_list.label: Eagle 列出智能文件夹
zh.action.smart_folder_list.description: 列出智能文件夹，可按 ID 筛选。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.smart_folder_rules.label: Eagle 获取智能文件夹规则
zh.action.smart_folder_rules.description: 获取可用的筛选规则 schema（属性、方法、值类型），用于构建合法的 conditions。
zh.action.smart_folder_create.label: Eagle 创建智能文件夹
zh.action.smart_folder_create.description: 按筛选条件创建智能文件夹；建议先用获取规则节点了解 schema。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.smart_folder_update.label: Eagle 更新智能文件夹
zh.action.smart_folder_update.description: 更新智能文件夹，仅修改提供的字段。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.smart_folder_remove.label: Eagle 删除智能文件夹
zh.action.smart_folder_remove.description: 删除智能文件夹及其所有子级。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.smart_folder_items.label: Eagle 获取智能文件夹条目
zh.action.smart_folder_items.description: 获取符合智能文件夹筛选条件的条目。需 Eagle 4.0 Build 22+。
zh.action.tag_list.label: Eagle 列出标签
zh.action.tag_list.description: 列出资源库标签，可按名称子串筛选，分页返回。
zh.action.tag_recent.label: Eagle 最近标签
zh.action.tag_starred.label: Eagle 收藏标签
zh.action.tag_rename.label: Eagle 重命名标签
zh.action.tag_rename.description: 重命名标签，所有使用该标签的条目会自动更新。
zh.action.tag_merge.label: Eagle 合并标签
zh.action.tag_merge.description: 将源标签合并到目标标签；合并后源标签会被移除。
zh.action.tag_group_list.label: Eagle 列出标签组
zh.action.tag_group_list.description: 列出所有标签组，分页返回。
zh.action.tag_group_create.label: Eagle 创建标签组
zh.action.tag_group_create.description: 创建包含指定标签的新标签组。
zh.action.tag_group_update.label: Eagle 更新标签组
zh.action.tag_group_update.description: 更新标签组；tags 会替换现有标签列表。
zh.action.tag_group_remove.label: Eagle 删除标签组
zh.action.tag_group_remove.description: 删除标签组；组内标签不会被删除，仅移除组本身。
zh.action.tag_group_add_tags.label: Eagle 向标签组添加标签
zh.action.tag_group_add_tags.description: 向标签组添加标签，可选择先从其当前所在组移除。
zh.action.tag_group_remove_tags.label: Eagle 从标签组移除标签
zh.action.tag_group_remove_tags.description: 从标签组移除标签；标签本身不会被删除。
zh.action.app_info.label: Eagle 应用信息
zh.action.app_info.description: 获取运行中的 Eagle 应用信息：版本、预发布、构建、平台。可用于检测 Eagle 是否运行。
zh.action.library_info.label: Eagle 资源库信息
zh.action.library_info.description: 获取当前打开的 Eagle 资源库元数据（名称、路径、文件夹、智能文件夹、标签组）。
zh.action.library_history.label: Eagle 资源库历史
zh.action.library_history.description: 获取历史资源库列表，分页返回。
zh.action.library_switch.label: Eagle 切换资源库
zh.action.library_switch.description: 按路径切换到指定资源库。
zh.action.ai_status.label: Eagle AI 搜索状态
zh.action.ai_status.description: 检查 AI 搜索可用性：安装、就绪、启动中、同步中、同步进度、服务健康。建议在 AI 搜索前调用。
zh.action.ai_search_text.label: Eagle AI 文字搜索
zh.action.ai_search_text.description: 按自然语言文字描述进行语义搜索。需安装并启用 AI 搜索插件。
zh.action.ai_search_base64.label: Eagle AI 以图搜图
zh.action.ai_search_base64.description: 通过 Base64 图片查找视觉相似的条目。需安装并启用 AI 搜索插件。
zh.action.ai_search_item.label: Eagle AI 相似条目
zh.action.ai_search_item.description: 查找与资源库中现有条目视觉相似的条目。需安装并启用 AI 搜索插件。

en.action.item_list.label: Eagle List Items
en.action.item_list.description: List Eagle library items with filters. Returns paginated results.
en.action.item_query.label: Eagle Full-text Search
en.action.item_query.description: Full-text search across item name, tags, annotation, URL, etc. Supports AND/OR/NOT and phrases.
en.action.item_count.label: Eagle Count Items
en.action.item_count.description: Return the total number of items in the library.
en.action.item_add.label: Eagle Add Item
en.action.item_add.description: Add items to Eagle from URL / local path / base64 / bookmark. Supports single or batch (items array).
en.action.item_update.label: Eagle Update Item
en.action.item_update.description: Update item metadata: name, tags, folders, annotation, star, etc. Only provided fields are modified.
en.action.item_set_thumbnail.label: Eagle Set Custom Thumbnail
en.action.item_set_thumbnail.description: Set a custom thumbnail for an item from a local image file.
en.action.item_refresh_thumbnail.label: Eagle Refresh Thumbnail
en.action.item_refresh_thumbnail.descriptio: Regenerate an item thumbnail and update size, dimensions, and color info.
en.action.item_get_comments.label: Eagle Get Comments
en.action.item_get_comments.description: Get all annotations (image region / video timeline) of an item. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.item_add_comment.label: Eagle Add Comment
en.action.item_add_comment.description: Add an annotation to an item. Image: provide x/y/width/height; Video: provide duration. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.item_update_comment.label: Eagle Update Comment
en.action.item_update_comment.description: Update an existing annotation. Only provided fields change. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.item_remove_comment.label: Eagle Remove Comment
en.action.item_remove_comment.description: Remove an annotation from an item. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.folder_list.label: Eagle List Folders
en.action.folder_list.description: List Eagle folders with optional filters. Returns paginated results.
en.action.folder_create.label: Eagle Create Folder
en.action.folder_create.description: Create a new folder in the library. Omit parent for a root-level folder.
en.action.folder_update.label: Eagle Update Folder
en.action.folder_update.description: Update folder metadata (name, description, tags, iconColor) or move it to another parent.
en.action.smart_folder_list.label: Eagle List Smart Folders
en.action.smart_folder_list.description: List smart folders, optionally filtered by ID(s). Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.smart_folder_rules.label: Eagle Get Smart Folder Rules
en.action.smart_folder_rules.description: Get the available filter rule schema (properties, methods, value types) for building smart folder conditions.
en.action.smart_folder_create.label: Eagle Create Smart Folder
en.action.smart_folder_create.description: Create a smart folder with filter conditions. Use get-rules first to build valid conditions. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.smart_folder_update.label: Eagle Update Smart Folder
en.action.smart_folder_update.description: Update a smart folder. Only provided fields are modified. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.smart_folder_remove.label: Eagle Remove Smart Folder
en.action.smart_folder_remove.description: Delete a smart folder and all its children. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.smart_folder_items.label: Eagle Get Smart Folder Items
en.action.smart_folder_items.description: Get items matching a smart folder filter conditions. Requires Eagle 4.0 Build 22+.
en.action.tag_list.label: Eagle List Tags
en.action.tag_list.description: List tags in the library, optionally filtered by name substring. Returns paginated results.
en.action.tag_recent.label: Eagle Recent Tags
en.action.tag_starred.label: Eagle Starred Tags
en.action.tag_rename.label: Eagle Rename Tag
en.action.tag_rename.description: Rename a tag. All items using it are updated automatically.
en.action.tag_merge.label: Eagle Merge Tags
en.action.tag_merge.description: Merge the source tag into the target tag. The source tag is removed afterwards.
en.action.tag_group_list.label: Eagle List Tag Groups
en.action.tag_group_list.description: List all tag groups. Returns paginated results.
en.action.tag_group_create.label: Eagle Create Tag Group
en.action.tag_group_create.description: Create a new tag group with tags.
en.action.tag_group_update.label: Eagle Update Tag Group
en.action.tag_group_update.description: Update a tag group. tags replaces the existing tag list.
en.action.tag_group_remove.label: Eagle Remove Tag Group
en.action.tag_group_remove.description: Delete a tag group. Tags inside are NOT deleted, only the group.
en.action.tag_group_add_tags.label: Eagle Add Tags To Group
en.action.tag_group_add_tags.description: Add tags to a tag group. Optionally remove them from their current group first.
en.action.tag_group_remove_tags.label: Eagle Remove Tags From Group
en.action.tag_group_remove_tags.description: Remove tags from a tag group. Tags themselves are not deleted.
en.action.app_info.label: Eagle App Info
en.action.app_info.description: Get running Eagle application info: version, prerelease, build, platform. Useful to check Eagle is running.
en.action.library_info.label: Eagle Library Info
en.action.library_info.description: Get metadata of the currently open Eagle library (name, path, folders, smart folders, tag groups).
en.action.library_history.label: Eagle Library History
en.action.library_history.description: Get the list of historical libraries. Returns paginated results.
en.action.library_switch.label: Eagle Switch Library
en.action.library_switch.description: Switch to another library by its path.
en.action.ai_status.label: Eagle AI Search Status
en.action.ai_status.description: Check AI Search availability: installed, ready, starting, syncing, sync progress, service health. Recommended before any AI search.
en.action.ai_search_text.label: Eagle AI Search By Text
en.action.ai_search_text.description: Semantic search by natural language text description. Requires the AI Search plugin installed and ready.
en.action.ai_search_base64.label: Eagle AI Search By Image
en.action.ai_search_base64.description: Find visually similar items via a Base64-encoded image. Requires the AI Search plugin.
en.action.ai_search_item.label: Eagle AI Search Similar Items
en.action.ai_search_item.description: Find items visually similar to an existing library item. Requires the AI Search plugin.
